coordinates.source_conversion: Existing drawing (x,y) -> (x*.025,-y*.025,z). Already applied to input fixture anchors. Do NOT multiply GLB by .025 again.
coordinates.presentation: Frontend preserves existing world placement and any explicit trail/stop display scale.

variants: One shared configurable assembly fitted to supplied anchors for FLOW / DROP / RIDGE. BIKE_FLOW/DROP/RIDGE are identity markers, not three duplicate meshes.
state_owner: Existing bike.js owns dynamics, geoPts, riderPts, challenges, saved garage and ski state. Controller accepts absolute endpoint poses only.

construction_offsets.grip_uses: GR; hands follow raised grip centres, correcting legacy CL-only hand positions

controls.tread: Source knob counts and relative kh/kw; authored kh*.006 m / kw*.012 m for credible construction. Illustrative pattern only; no grip coefficient calculated from mesh.
controls.wheel_spin: Supplied absolute angle around local +Z. Frontend uses -dist/.375, -sx/.375, -gspin or zero as appropriate.
controls.coil: Supplied SH0/SH1 endpoints; axial visual scale only, no rebound calculation.
controls.rider: Source body points; hands attached to actual GR-derived grips instead of legacy CL height. Shoe soles meet pedal top. No rider balance model.
controls.labels: Blank plate/tag surfaces and anchors, frontend-generated text only.
controls.heat: Supplied normalized visual cue. Existing rotorT upper estimate remains frontend-owned; no smoke/fire threshold.

limitations: Source frame deformation is illustrative and not a physical four-bar linkage.
Tread dimensions and rider proportions do not determine mass, friction or drag.
Offline renders and browser appearance require separate review.
No website, ski branch, physics or challenge changes.

resource_policy.standard_behavior: Configured ordinary meshes without batching. Higher call count; same pose controls. Capability chosen before scene attachment; partial allocation rolls back.
